errors.text_span: ihre Reihenfolge ist nicht alphabetisch oder nach Werten sortiert
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are not sorted by value, but they are clearly sorted in descending order of their values from left to right.

The values provided for Japan, Sweden, the USA, and the United Kingdom are incorrect. The chart shows their values are approximately 18.5%, 16%, 15.5%, and 8.5% respectively, not 28%, 22%, 21%, and 19%.

errors.text_span: Die verbleibenden Balken für OECD, Deutschland, Dänemark, EU27, Polen, Frankreich, Italien und Spanien haben Werte zwischen ungefähr 8 % und 14 %.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. While OECD is within this range (at ~11.5%), all other listed entities have values below 8% (e.g., Deutschland is ~7%, Dänemark is ~6.5%, EU27 is ~4.5%, etc.).

errors.text_span: Alle Balken haben eine einheitliche blaue Farbe.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bars for OECD and EU27 are a different color (mauve/purple) from the other bars, which are blue.
